pele_data.source: Silver Bulletin (natesilver.net) PELE charts, via Datawrapper's public version CDN
pele_data.timestamp_source: HTTP Last-Modified of each immutable version

protocol.outcome: Proper 3-outcome scoring: home win / draw / away win from the recorded score. Draws are their own outcome (not dropped, not split). Knockout scores include extra time where played and a shootout counts as a draw; both models are graded on the identical label.
protocol.pele_side: Last PELE Datawrapper version published (HTTP Last-Modified) before a deadline: the exact kickoff where our fixture feed has it (21 knockout matches); otherwise 15:00 UTC on the earlier of PELE's date label and the venue-local match date (every 2026 kickoff was >= 16:00 UTC local-date). So group-stage PELE numbers can be up to a day older than PELE's true last pre-kickoff version -- conservative, never later.
protocol.replay_side: Layer 1 trained on 1992-01-01 to 2026-06-11 only; Elo/form strictly before each match date; all matches scored neutral=True, as in production.
protocol.live_side: Newest version of dashboard/data/upcoming_matches.json committed to the public repo before kickoff (git commit time).
protocol.tests: Paired percentile bootstrap (10k) 95% CI of the mean per-match score difference; two-sided paired sign-flip randomization p-value.

ablation_host_advantage.idea: Score co-host matches as home games (PELE's venue-level home advantage) instead of neutral

method_differences.pele: Zero-sum Elo over ~50k matches since 1872; harmonic goal margin (2nd goal worth 1/2, 3rd 1/3...)
method_differences.ours: Zero-sum Elo since 1872 with an eloratings-style goal-difference multiplier; fed to a stacked ensemble alongside rolling form and FIFA points

method_differences.pele: Transfermarkt squad values (top-23, position-weighted, ~30% UEFA-club discount), official WC rosters, injuries/suspensions
Slow reversion toward a prior built from log GDP (PPP), footballing legacy year and region
Era-, distance-, altitude- and team-specific; venue-level for co-hosts
method_differences.ours: Learned 'neutral' flag; every World Cup match scored as neutral in production

method_differences.pele: Negative-binomial score matrix with a correlation term + team 'tilt' (attacking/defensive style) -> W/D/L
method_differences.ours: Direct 3-class probabilities from an XGBoost + Elo-logistic + FIFA-heuristic stack with a logistic meta-learner

method_differences.pele: Extra time modeled (~40% of draws resolved) then skill-weighted penalties; knockout rating gap x1.1
100,000 sims incl. group tiebreakers, cards (fair play), 'hot' in-sim rating updates
method_differences.ours: 10,000 sims of the actual remaining bracket from the knockout stage
